The primary text misnames the sequences with intermediate ordinal positions; Figures 6/S3 identify two-arcs and two-squares. Fourth-position transfer and irregular-control nulls remain explicit. Sensor-subset performance is not anatomical source localization, and eye controls do not exclude unresolved microsaccades. Raw measurements and external analysis dependencies were not reproduced.
